title: Transfer, Trade-Up and Records Retention Terms of the Belrose Jewelry Protection and Care Plans
content:
Whether a plan of the Belrose Jewelry Protection and Care Plans may pass with the piece to a new owner, what that costs, whether an inspection must be logged first, whether the coverage carries over when the piece is traded up, and how long claim documentation is kept are fixed per plan below.

| | Manufacturer Limited Warranty | Belrose Care Plan 2-Year | Belrose Care Plan 3-Year | Belrose Care Plan 5-Year | Belrose Lifetime Care Plan | Belrose Heirloom Protection Plan |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| The plan may be transferred with the piece to a new owner | no | no | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| Fee charged to transfer the plan | 0.00 USD | 0.00 USD | 45.00 USD | 45.00 USD | 75.00 USD | 150.00 USD |
| An inspection must be logged before a transfer takes effect | no | no | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| The coverage carries over when the covered piece is traded up | no | no | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| Whole years claim documentation is retained for | 3 | 5 | 5 | 7 | 10 | 10 |

## Questions these terms answer

**May a Belrose Care Plan 2-Year be transferred?** No; transfer is admitted only from the Belrose Care Plan 3-Year upward, and neither the Manufacturer Limited Warranty nor the 2-Year plan carries over on a trade-up either.

**What does a transfer cost on the Belrose Heirloom Protection Plan?** 150.00 USD, the highest in the family; the Belrose Lifetime Care Plan charges 75.00 USD and the 3-Year and 5-Year plans 45.00 USD each.

**On which plans must an inspection be logged before the transfer takes effect?** On every plan that admits transfer at all: the 3-Year, 5-Year, Lifetime and Heirloom plans.

**How long are claim papers kept?** 3 years on the Manufacturer Limited Warranty, 5 on the 2-Year and 3-Year plans, 7 on the 5-Year plan and 10 on the two lifetime plans.
